fato_historico: 1995: Oklahoma City bombing: Timothy McVeigh and Terry Nichols are indicted for the bombing. Michael Fortier pleads guilty in a plea-bargain for his testimony.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a profound sense of justice and healing. Much like the quiet resolve found in seeking truth after challenging times, consider how you can mend personal bonds. It is a good time to release past burdens and let your spirit flow towards peaceful resolutions, allowing your innate compassion to bloom like a vibrant four-leaf clover.
frase_do_dia: True peace emerges when you choose healing over the weight of the past.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual awareness and building better foundations.
conselho: Focus on forgiving yourself and others to clear space for new joyful beginnings.
